findings.finding: parseCssColor throws a raw TypeError instead of returning a failure Result, for the entire empty-argument color-function class, in the immutable published 4.0.0 — the package whose own description reads "failure-explicit".
findings.evidence: Probe run from /Users/mkbabb/Programming/glass-ui against the real installed tarball: `import('@mkbabb/value.js/css').then(m=>m.parseCssColor('oklch()'))` → `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')`. 18 inputs probed, 9 THROW: oklch() rgb() hsl() lab() color() rgba() hwb() oklab() lch() xyz() rgb(   ). Contrast: color-mix(in oklab, red, blue), oklch(from red l c h), light-dark(red,blue) all correctly return {ok:false}. Source site src/css/grammar.ts:181 `const components = splitTopLevel(slash[0]!.replace(/,/g, " "), "space");` — splitTopLevel("","/") returns [] (src/css/grammar.ts:63-80), so slash[0] is undefined. tsconfig.base.json:10 sets "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true — the type system typed slash[0] as string|undefined and the `!` overrode it; eslint.config.js has no @typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion rule (grep 'non-null' → 0 hits). findings.finding: The PNG byte-exactness gate never invokes a real PNG decoder despite the test being named 'decodes to the W8 raster'. It uses its own parseChunks and a purpose-built inflateStored commented 'Inflate a zlib stream of stored blocks only (this encoder emits nothing else)'. D57 reports this as decode evidence.
findings.evidence: demo/test/export/byte-exact.test.ts — 'it("decodes to the W8 raster: filter bytes 0x00 and toRgba8 spans", …)' uses inflateStored; 'function inflateStored(idat) { expect(idat[0]).toBe(0x78); expect(idat[1]).toBe(0x01); … }' with a hand-rolled stored-block loop. No zlib/pngjs/sharp import. DECISIONS.md:85 (D57) 'DETERMINISTIC no-canvas PNG … Adler-32 + per-chunk CRC verified'.
findings.mechanism: masked fallback / near-vacuous gate. Named RED input the gate cannot produce: emit an IHDR with a colour-type/bit-depth pair no decoder accepts (e.g. colour-type 3 with no PLTE) — parseChunks never validates IHDR semantics and inflateStored never sees it, so the gate stays green while every real viewer rejects the file. Credit where due: the zlib header IS asserted (0x78 0x01) and the CRC table is an independent copy of the IEEE polynomial, so a polynomial change in png.ts would go red.

findings.finding: green-over-broken — parseCssColor, the headline function of a package whose description field reads "failure-explicit", throws TypeError on every empty-body functional-color input, in the built dist at HEAD, under a fully GREEN gate ladder
findings.evidence: Probe against ./dist/subpaths/css.js: over {rgb,rgba,hsl,hsla,hwb,lab,lch,oklab,oklch,color,light-dark,color-mix,device-cmyk,foo} x {"","   ","/","\t"} → CRASHING inputs (56), SOFT inputs (0). Example: parseCssColor("oklch()") -> TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace'). Crash site src/css/grammar.ts:181 `const components = splitTopLevel(slash[0]!.replace(/,/g, " "), "space");`. Every OTHER v4 entry point probed is failure-explicit (parseCssValue("calc("), parseTimingFunction("steps()"), parseStylesheet("a{"), quantizePixels(empty,0), mixColors(null,null,.5), serializeCssColor(null) all return typed Results). package.json:4 = "Immutable, failure-explicit CSS color…". `npm test` at the same commit: 25 files / 346 tests, all passed.
findings.mechanism: splitTopLevel("","/") returns []; slash[0] is undefined; the non-null assertion `!` defeats noUncheckedIndexedAccess:true (enabled in tsconfig.base.json); .replace throws. Name dispatch happens on the NEXT line, so even foo() crashes. No test in the corpus feeds malformed arity — the only negative parseCssColor cases in all 25 test files are "kelvin(6500)", "var(--accent)", "not-a-color", "SelectedItem". No enabled eslint rule flags non-null assertions (only 1 rule is enabled repo-wide). So typecheck, lint, tests and the packed-surface gate all pass over a shipped crash.

findings.finding: vacuous gate — `eslint . --max-warnings=0` runs with exactly ONE rule enabled repo-wide, and two of the three no-restricted-imports objects guard an import alias that W43 deleted, making their RED input unconstructible
findings.evidence: `npx eslint --print-config src/color/index.ts` → TOTAL rules listed: 40, ENABLED rules: 1 (["no-restricted-imports"]). Same result for demo/@/composables/color/useColorModel.ts, demo/color-picker/main.ts, demo/color-picker/App.vue. eslint.config.js never spreads js.configs.recommended, typescript-eslint, or vue flat/recommended — its ~60 "off" entries are no-ops. Config header eslint.config.js:4-6: "The rule set is intentionally permissive — this is a smoke gate (CI must pass), not opinionated linting. Tightening is deferred to a later wave." G-DEMO-3a/3b ban group ["@components/custom/palette-browser/**/*.vue"] and ["@components/custom/*/composables/**"]; `grep -rnE "^\s*(import|export).*@components/" demo | wc -l` → 0 (tsconfig.demo.json:38-40 records "W43 (RF-15): the demo `@…` path aliases were killed"). Only surviving @components/ string in demo/ is a comment at demo/palettes/browser/status/index.ts:5.
findings.mechanism: A flat config that lists rules as "off" without ever enabling a base preset enables nothing. The gate can only fail on (a) a src/**.ts importing @mkbabb/glass-ui, (b) a demo/@/composables file importing **/color-picker/**, or (c) a parse error. It cannot catch no-undef, no-unused-vars, no-redeclare, getter-return, valid-typeof, no-fallthrough, no-import-assign, no-setter-return, no-explicit-any, or — decisively — @typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion, the rule that would flag all 152 `!` sites in src/ including the GS-1 crash. Deferral originated 2026-05-19 at 6ca20464 (D.W1 §L7) and has ridden ~16 closes with four subsequent edits, none enabling a rule.

pathologies.theKillingChange: An identifier is minted ONCE, namespaced to its origin tranche (A19, D-BBNF, U:B5), and is IMMUTABLE for the life of the repository. A row's PREDICATE — the exact sentence whose truth closes it — is FROZEN at first booking, and may be changed only by an explicit owner supersession row that quotes the old predicate verbatim, states why it no longer holds, and mints a NEW identifier for the successor. The carry counter travels with the identifier and NEVER RESETS. At carry >= 2 the row is a DISEASE ROW: it gets its own wave, and that wave may end only in LANDED or RETIRED-BY-OWNER. WHY IT KILLS: a chronic can no longer hide inside a larger successor. When 'wire it' became 'prove it visibly runs', that would have been forced into the open as a NEW identifier with carry 0 — and A02 aurora-derive would have been forced to close LANDED at N.W5, which is what actually happened. Seventeen closes of carry become one close plus one honest new row. NOTE the corpus ALREADY CONTAINS this rule and does not enforce it: docs/tranches/V/vnext/RETURN-CONTRACT.md:131 'A twice-deferred chronic gets its own decision wave' — no such wave exists for any of the eight riders. Writing the rule again is not the fix; making the identifier immutable is, because then the rule becomes checkable by grep.

families.mechanism: Self-scoped gate — the acceptance predicate is evaluated over exactly the files the wave just wrote or just cleaned, so the only possible RED is a regression the wave itself introduces; live violations one directory away are invisible. The tell in every instance is that the eventual fix was to widen the scan root.

Gate without a runner — the threshold survives as config or prose while its executor is deleted or never wired, so the file reads as a live hard gate to any future auditor while no input can redden it (lighthouserc.json, test:e2e, 185 unrun Playwright tests, boot-smoke, css-emission-probe, oracle-slate-teeth, e2e/visual never authored, 193 vnext gates naming a nonexistent runner).

Disposition space with no failing state — the close's own verdict vocabulary exhausts the outcomes with only non-failing labels, so 'not done' maps to a pass (PP-16's complete/complete_with_misses, the zero-drop criterion's unconditional BOOKED arm, DEFERRED-to-ZERO by renaming, RP-2's RE-BASELINE verdict, HG-A10's 'skip quietly', T.W9's unbounded escalate arm).

Self-certifying acceptance — the entity that would report failure is the entity being measured, so authoring the row satisfies the gate (close-ceremony self-assertions, naming-is-the-gate annexes, 'visibly changes', 'zero new gap', a wave authoring its own before-frame, and CLEAN defined as twelve self-authored selftests exiting 0 with a byte ceiling that rejects long adversarial reports).

Green-by-absence — a presence/absence predicate passes silently once its subject stops existing (git status on a deleted path, eslint bans on a dead alias, completion conditions satisfied by 'No such file', gates guarding artifacts deleted in the same commit, tsconfig paths to missing .d.ts).

Predicate substitution at close — the charter names a verification command and the close reports a different, softer predicate as satisfaction (grep→'palette-field survivors', exit-0→'= baseline', wc -l→an estimate, scratch-branch-red→a green push, non-200→a permanent 301, a whole-product taste verdict→'two files read nicely').

Identifier mutation and namespace collision — a row's id and predicate change at each close, resetting the carry clock and mis-routing every join; aggravated by three simultaneous live B1..Bn series, two live CH-4s, two live O-5s and a recycled CH-6.

Event-bound trigger on a third party — retirement is conditioned on an external actor's action, so the row cannot be decided from inside the repo; each close re-verifies the block and counts the re-verification as diligence. Asserted TIME-BOUND by F/FINAL.md:128 and EVENT-BOUND in every instance.

Wave-sized vacuum — an entire wave is trigger-gated or simply unexecuted, and its non-firing is recorded as a non-miss, carrying the whole payload forward invisibly (T.W7's 8 rows, K's six commitless waves, M's nine, N.W6/W8/W9/W10-18, V-prime 10-of-18, vnext 193-of-193).

Green-over-broken at the product boundary — every component gate passes while the assembled product is broken, unreachable or undeployed (a backend rewrite behind tsc with zero tests, admin specs against a total network stub, a 428 outage shipped by a deferral, e2e 0-of-37, R1 crashing under a green ladder, an export nobody reaches, a production build that mounts empty, master CI red with 11 skipped deploys).

Masked fallback — the defect is absorbed by a catch, a default, a soft CI step or a reclassification, so no signal reaches any gate (a probe documented to 'screenshot and pass', ~20 catch→console.warn sites on the export path, continue-on-error steps carrying known reds, 'environmental' as an unbounded class, a PNG 'decode' gate with a hand-rolled inflater).

Declared capture missing or untracked — the close cites evidence that is absent, in /tmp, in an agent job dir, or untracked, and the tranche's own evidence law disqualifies it (n-verify-V4.md never existed yet justified superseding M; 574 of 625 Q/R/S visual files untracked; proportion-register.md is the untracked design authority for nine waves).

Silent drop under a zero-drop claim — an item stops being mentioned and the zero-drop gate audits the close document against itself, so a row that was never booked cannot be detected (six undisclosed D deferrals, A-19's housekeeping half, 19 of 20 W8 brackets, DOC-1..13, U-F72/73/74, the CH-4 close-law and W54 D-1 absent from all 193 vnext waves).

Partial counted as done — a partial completion receives a terminal disposition (NO LEGACY CODE 'HONORED' with the deletion one tranche away, 31→11 as LANDED, god modules 2→1 filed as census 0, three re-gates delivered as two with both falsifiers waived, 'two STANDING CI-wired guards' of which one was never wired and both died in four days).

Alias smuggling under a clean-break law — a shim, dual path or renamed deferral ships while the close asserts the break (a local reimplementation keeping a dead parameter for 'signature parity with the retired producer composable'; the development export condition removed by D, re-added by K and published; a legacy status field dual-written under a NO-legacy banner).

Owner edict inverted by a later close — an explicit prohibition or order is reversed, usually at greater scale, and no close sweep flags it (the proof:* idiom deleted by owner order then rebuilt to 11, then 11 again, now 81 sites and a 44-tool/9,837-LOC farm; 3x5x3 encoded as 2+1; 'no ncsu alias' satisfied by making the alias permanent).

Ground-truth circularity and coverage deletion — correctness asserted against the implementation's own formula, or coverage deleted under a subject line advertising addition (external anchors cured then deleted with the circularity restored at test/v4-color-behavior.test.ts:66; 3b5956d0 removing 70 files/17,198 lines under 'producer-surface behavior tests'; a lying BBNF test renamed to preserve a count gate).

Canon drift — an authority document describes a tree that no longer exists, and the guard that would have caught it was deleted together with the canon it guarded (MEMORY false in 7 of 9 concrete rows; CLAUDE.md and canon-sync both deleted; EVIDENCE.md with zero rows for any live wave; source comments citing deleted probes and a nonexistent workflow).

Deadline bound to a wave that can decline to close — a kill-date or trigger is bound to a wave rather than a calendar date, so it is unsatisfiable when the wave never runs; and when such a trigger does fire externally, nothing observes it (VAL-1 died three tranches late; a ratified v1.0.0 verdict evaporated; kf and vue-router triggers fired unnoticed for weeks).

Close-of-record integrity — the FINAL.md is absent, retro-authored by a successor tranche, or certified against an uncommitted tree, so its claims were never checkable at close (K has none and six commitless waves; N's was written by R claiming waves that died; J certified 140/140 on an uncommitted tree; every tag v0.12.0..v1.0.2 minted on one day).

Closing over an admittedly unsatisfied owner gate — a decision reserved to the owner is named, not taken, and the wave closes anyway; naming becomes the discharge (HG6's empty stub across three closes while T merged and tagged; 11 owner-attest rows unattested though their trigger fired twice; OC-1/OC-2 unruled with OC-2 'adopted in substance' by the authoring program).

Magnitude drift without an add/remove event — a row's size is re-measured at each close, moves in both directions, and is never resolved; and headline counters are quoted from stale or fabricated sources (glass asks 8→7→7→8→9→11; blob consumers 11→16→10; Color.try 11→12→3 with no threshold; a repair score summing to 17 over a 20-row ledger; strictTypes 62 printed from a source literal).
